name: mediarr
description: Mediarr is a unified, all-in-one media management powerhouse designed to replace the fragmented "arr" stack (Sonarr, Radarr, Bazarr, Prowlarr) with a single, modern interface and a high-performance integrated backend.

scripts.start:api: DATABASE_URL="file:$(pwd)/mediarr.db" bun --no-addons server/src/main.ts || DATABASE_URL="file:$(pwd)/mediarr.db" tsx server/src/main.ts
scripts.dev: DATABASE_URL="file:$(pwd)/mediarr.db" API_PORT=5174 ENCRYPTION_KEY=dev-local-encryption-key DEFINITIONS_PATH="$(pwd)/server/definitions" npm run dev --workspace=server & DATABASE_URL="file:$(pwd)/mediarr.db" API_INTERNAL_URL=http://localhost:5174 npm run dev --workspace=app
scripts.test:connectivity: cd tests/connectivity && podman compose up --build --abort-on-container-exit --exit-code-from client-test; podman compose down
